item.title: [Lanka Talks] Mastering the flags: meet the five winners of Kaspersky{CTF}
item.description: Five standout teams — Fluid Attacks, Colombia, Security Hub, Italy, Odin from ENKI WhiteHat, South Korea, VoidSec from IKLIGHT, Morocco, and CUT from Central University, Russia — emerged as the winners of the global competition, Kaspersky{CTF}, which concluded on the 30th of August. The 2026 edition featured corporate and academic teams competing in a Jeopardy-style format across five regions, uniting participants for 24 hours of security challenges.

item.title: [Ada Derana Biz English] Dr. Nandalal Weerasinghe to keynote Planters’ Association AGM
item.description:
Governor of the Central Bank Sri Lanka, Dr. Nandalal Weerasinghe, will grace the 172nd Annual General Meeting of the Planters’ Association of Ceylon (PAC) as its Chief Guest. The AGM on Saturday, 19th September will bring together Regional Plantation Companies (RPCs), industry leaders and key stakeholders, to review the sector’s performance and shape strategies for its continued contribution to the national economy.
